follow_up_advice: Return if no improvement in 72 hours

renal_reason: Avoid or reduce dose in significant renal impairment — NSAID nephrotoxicity risk
hepatic_reason: Use caution with elevated LFTs or known hepatic disease
counselling_notes: Take with food; do not exceed max daily dose
